note: Checksums verified in the rehabilitation audit. classes_verified=false because no label artifact (dataset, training code, or checkpoint metadata) exists in the repository to prove index-to-name ordering; treat class names as best-effort labels from the legacy app source.

tomato.preprocessing: resize bilinear to 256x256, rescale 1/255 (matches legacy app; training-pipeline provenance unverified)
tomato.framework: tensorflow (Keras 2-era SavedModel; loads via load_model on TF<=2.15 or TFSMLayer on Keras 3)
tomato.known_limitations: Small custom CNN (~0.5M params), not the MobileNetV2 field model reported in the PMLR v319 paper. Uncalibrated outputs. Class-index ordering unverified. Likely trained on PlantVillage-style imagery; expect degraded accuracy on real field photos.
